title: Show books currently being read
description:
## Outcome
Let a reader focus on books they are reading.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Selecting Reading shows only reading books in their original order.
- [ ] Selecting All restores every book without changing stored data.
- [ ] The filter is keyboard accessible and matches the attached visual guidance.
